name: retrieval_coverage_v1
purpose: Read-only mainline feasibility audit: test whether rank-then-guard hides an eligible alternative, and measure structural support of the already-observed diagnostic library.
source: All128 saved capacity initial states plus all32 paired dynamics initial states, existing final3-skill diagnostic library. In-sample/offline evidence; no held-out performance claim.
comparison: Current top1-then-guard versus hypothetical highest-scoring guarded-valid candidate, same .8 retrieval threshold and original similarity/utility. Do not mutate any library or production path.
decision: If any eligible alternatives are missed, document exact cases before a separately named fix. If none are missed, do not implement a retrieval repair or widen this audit. Report reference action lengths and task BFS strata; no model benefit claim.
